up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5241112'. For each such molecule, retrieve the following columns: its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), its maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). The molecules are linked to the document via compound_records: first identify the doc_id corresponding to the document's ChEMBL ID in the docs table, then join compound_records on doc_id, then join molecule_dictionary on molregno, and finally join compound_structures on molregno. Return the results sorted alphabetically by molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Ensure that each qualifying molecule appears only once in the output (distinct on the molecule ChEMBL ID).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5241112' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
